_about: Wall-panel wall spec, AP Capital second floor: MASTER BEDROOM (TM 260326, DWG 'rev 2' 2026-07-08 = PDF rev 3/4 without Andriy's red survey marks). mm, wall-local: x along the wall from its left end as seen from the room (pier reveals: as seen from the opening), z up from the SUBFLOOR (survey zero; FFL +57.15 as the other AP rooms), y = 0 at the wall face, negative toward the room. UCON survey = ~/Documents/AP_SF_Master_Bedroom_V0.1.skp (probe 930, 2026-10-20): room 8790 x 7888, ceiling 3152 everywhere. Andriy 2026-10-20: our survey governs, TM numbers only to compare (G-002); panel numbers = TM 1-21; STONE BASEBOARD as Bedroom 3 (Passione sheet 25: 8" stone base with riglet) - panels on the stone 260.35, 10 to the ceiling, joints 10; doors her / his as Bedroom 3 D01 (TM concealed frame, one stop on the hinge side, U casing, swing on A-501), openings to the ceiling (no lintels); Wall 4 runs through both corners; built-in cabinets in the Wall 2 / Wall 3 corner (700, TM).
